reviews.comment: Dr. J is an amazing lecturer. He breaks things down crisp and concise. The one downside of CHEN204 is that the homework is done with WileyPlus. These homeworks take hours and hours. His exams are also difficult, but fair given the nature of the course. Great professor, but work harder than any of your other classes if you want to do well.

Wow what a professor. By far the hardest class I've taken in college but the most rewarding. Incredible lectures, caring, and truly cares and wants you to succeed. More than anything, he is looking for you to improve, and if he sees you truly understand the material you'll be OK. Also shoutout to Jason Eades, best TA I have ever had.

Dr. J was an amazing teacher! CHEN 204, in general, is a difficult class, so I would definitely recommend taking his class if it is an option. His lectures are great, so be sure to attend, or you will probably fall behind. The exams were difficult, but they helped prepare you for later courses that you are required to take.

Absolute best professor I have had yet. Lectures were structured very well, and he was very helpful during office hours. Although his exams are very difficult, it will prepare you best for chemical engineering. Take him for 204, and you will learn the fundamentals of this major down to the core.

Dr. J was very tough, but will prepare you the best for chemical engineering. His lectures were very thorough, and he will help you in office hours. He also offers a lot of extra credit. Though his exams are very hard, you will learn a lot.

Chen 204 is the hardest class I've ever taken in my life. Hate the course not the teacher. Compared to Mashuga, AJ is the GOAT. His lectures are literal problems form the textbook and his quizzes, he will help you on. (sometimes). Very reasonable and he tried everything to help us with our grade. Kind sweet man. If its between Chad and AJ, take AJ.

Dr. J is the GOAT. His class and exams in general were very challenging, and take time to adjust to, but his teaching style and passion that he brings to the class is worth it. I don't think I've learned as much in a single other course as this one, and he is very approachable through email and outside of class. He truly wants you to succeed.

Professor Jayaraman is a nice man, but his teaching was not the best. The content was difficult but covered very quickly. Exams are super difficult and super hard grading doesn't help either. Homeworks were also hard but manageable. I'd recommend trying to get another professor for this course. Go to recitations and solve the problems. Good luck.

204 is a difficult course. Jayaraman is a solid choice and he knows his stuff. He is very helpful during office hours and so are the TA's. He provided an extra credit assignment for an extra 10% on the final exam which was a great help.

I liked him as a person. He was very caring and wants to help. He was SO difficult though. Very touch grader. His exams were rough. Make sure you go to all lectures and recitations or you will be very lost. I think it would've been helpful if he was more organized with Canvas.

Dr. Arul is very knowledgeable, humble, passionate, and caring as a professor. This course can definitely be difficult, especially the homework, but he works out problems in office hours so definitely go to those. He pulls example questions from the book so there's a lot of practice before exams. Overall a really solid professor
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a very nice and knowledge professor who will teach you a ton. He is definitely tough but he is willing to help you whenever you may need it. He is also a hard grader but is fair about it and you can talk to him about your grade and most likely get points back. Overall he will prepare you the best for chemical engineering.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. AJ was a great professor for Chen 204. I was worried about my first chemical engineering class but he made lecture enjoyable. He will challenge you more than other professors when it comes to homework and example problems in class, but since this class has common exams, you will be much more prepared than others. 10/10 experience.Very smart guy

Dr. Jayaramen is an excellent teacher and strives to deliver a deep understanding of the concepts of mass balances, and later, energy balances. His expectations mean that you need to understand the concepts fundamentally in order to perform, but if you get through it, you will come out knowing far more than you did going in. Tests are fast-paced.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is super hard so make sure do to all the hw and do not use chegg!! Your grade is made up by 2 midterms worth 20% each, final worth 30%, and the rest is hw/quizzes. Not my fav professor but it was ok. If you can get Gagnon he came as a sub and was a lot more clear. good luck lol

Dr. AJ wasnt too bad of a professor. He taught the lectures very well and it came down to if you read the textbook enough. I highly recommend getting in a study group for this class or you wont pass. If you are an all As student, chances are this might be your first B or possibly C.
Worst Chen 204 professor you will be better off any other professor. DO NOT TAKE HIM! Had to invest 5 hour out of class almost every week for a decent grade.

AJ did not do a very good job teaching this online class. He would pull formulas out of nowhere and his lectures were not always clear. As hard as this class was though, he is probably the best professor for CHEN 382 at A&M. If you need to get this class out of the way, take him. However, if you truly want to learn the material, take another prof.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: he's very clear and helpful; he really cares about you actually learning the material. great professor
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: His lectures explain things fairly well, but don't always cover everything you need to know for the homework or tests. The lectures cover the basics, then the homework goes into more detail, and then the tests are very difficult in the time given. His accent wasn't hard for me to understand though. He's good at answering questions well too.
He's good at giving fairly clear lectures. His tests can be brutal though, and hard to prepare for sometimes.

Good prof, really enjoy his lectures. His tests can be anywhere from pretty straightforward to really, really difficult. If you're doing well on the homework, you should be able to get a B pretty easily. If you're in the honors section, you have the best chance of getting an A because of the ASPEN project. He does curve class, especially for nonhon
This teacher does not explain very well. He tests you on thing which he has not covered at all. Most of the students got low grades, he is not a great teacher.
Dr. J was very helpful throughout the semester, and is understanding when you have difficulties. Would definitely recommend him to any aspiring Chemical Engineers.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
